rules.title: 除 root 外不存在 UID=0 的账户
standard_refs: 等保2.0-三级-8.1.4.1 身份鉴别

collect.query: SELECT username FROM users WHERE uid=0 AND username!='root';

rules.remediation_template: 非 root 的 UID=0 账户是越权风险；核实身份后删除或改 UID：`usermod -u <newuid> <user>`。

rules.title: 不存在重复的 UID

collect.query: SELECT uid, count(*) AS c FROM users GROUP BY uid HAVING c > 1;

rules.remediation_template: 重复 UID 使权限归属混乱；为多余账户分配唯一 UID。

rules.title: 不存在重复的用户名

collect.query: SELECT username, count(*) AS c FROM users GROUP BY username HAVING c > 1;

rules.remediation_template: 重复用户名会导致鉴别歧义；重命名冲突账户。

rules.title: 不存在空口令账户

collect.query: SELECT username FROM shadow WHERE password_status='empty';

rules.remediation_template: 空口令账户可被直接登录；`passwd -l <user>` 锁定或设置强口令。

rules.title: 系统账户（UID<1000）均为不可登录 shell

collect.query: SELECT username FROM users WHERE uid<1000 AND uid!=0 AND shell NOT IN ('/usr/sbin/nologin','/sbin/nologin','/bin/false');

rules.remediation_template: 系统账户不应可交互登录；`usermod -s /usr/sbin/nologin <user>`。

rules.title: root 是唯一 GID=0 的属主账户

collect.query: SELECT username FROM users WHERE gid=0 AND username!='root';

rules.remediation_template: 核实非 root 的 GID=0 账户，调整其主组。

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\EnableICMPRedirect';

rules.title: 禁止 WDigest 明文缓存凭据（防 mimikatz）

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest\UseLogonCredential';

rules.title: 启用 LSASS 保护进程（RunAsPPL）

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL';

rules.title: 禁止存储 LM 哈希

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\NoLMHash';

rules.title: 禁止向 SMB 服务器发送明文口令

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters\EnablePlainTextPassword';

rules.title: 禁用自动登录

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\AutoAdminLogon';

rules.remediation_template: 设置 AutoAdminLogon=0 并清除明文口令。

rules.title: 缓存登录凭据数不超过 4

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\CachedLogonsCount';

rules.title: 禁止以提升权限安装 MSI

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer\AlwaysInstallElevated';

rules.title: 内置管理员启用管理审批模式

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\FilterAdministratorToken';

rules.title: 未禁用自动更新
standard_refs: 等保2.0-三级-8.1.5 补丁管理

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU\NoAutoUpdate';

rules.title: 自动更新配置为自动下载并计划安装

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU\AUOptions';

rules.title: 未禁用 Defender 实时监控

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection\DisableRealtimeMonitoring';

rules.title: 启用 PowerShell 脚本块日志

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging\EnableScriptBlockLogging';

rules.title: 禁用 LLMNR（防投毒）

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient\EnableMulticast';

rules.title: 交互登录空闲锁屏不超过 900 秒

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\InactivityTimeoutSecs';

rules.title: 审计特权使用（备份/还原权限）

collect.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE path='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FullPrivilegeAuditing';

rules.title: 禁用传真服务

collect.query: SELECT start_type FROM services WHERE name='Fax';

rules.remediation_template: 禁用 Windows 服务 Fax：`sc config Fax start= disabled` 并 `sc stop Fax`。

rules.title: 禁用 WMP 网络共享服务

collect.query: SELECT start_type FROM services WHERE name='WMPNetworkSvc';

rules.remediation_template: 禁用 Windows 服务 WMPNetworkSvc：`sc config WMPNetworkSvc start= disabled` 并 `sc stop WMPNetworkSvc`。

rules.title: 禁用 WSL 管理服务（如未使用）

collect.query: SELECT start_type FROM services WHERE name='LxssManager';

rules.remediation_template: 禁用 Windows 服务 LxssManager：`sc config LxssManager start= disabled` 并 `sc stop LxssManager`。

rules.title: 禁用远程桌面配置服务（如未使用）

collect.query: SELECT start_type FROM services WHERE name='SessionEnv';

rules.remediation_template: 禁用 Windows 服务 SessionEnv：`sc config SessionEnv start= disabled` 并 `sc stop SessionEnv`。
